verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ልህቀ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ረሥአ ፡ ወተሐምጋ ፡ አዕይንቲሁ ፡ ወኢይሬኢ ፡ ወጸውዖ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ ወልዱ ፡
                  ዘይልህቅ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after Isaac was old, that his eyes were dimmed so that he could not see; and he called Esau, his elder son, and said to him, My son; and he said, Behold, I am here.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after Isaac was old, that his eyes were dimmed so that he could not see; and he called Esau, his elder son, and said to him, My son; and he said, Behold, I am here.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a îmbătrânit Isaac şi au slăbit vederile ochilor săi, a chemat pe Isav, pe fiul său cel mai mare, şi i-a zis: "Fiul meu!" Zis-a acela: "Iată-mă!"
translations.grk: Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὸ γηράσαι τὸν Ἰσαὰκ, καὶ ἠμβλύνθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ τοῦ ὁρᾷν, καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ἡσαῦ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν πρεσβύτερον, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, υἱέ μου· καὶ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ ἐγώ.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ረሣዕኩ ፡ ወኢያአምር ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ሞትየ ።
verses.translation: And he said, Behold, I am grown old, and know not the day of my death.

translations.lxx: And he said, Behold, I am grown old, and know not the day of my death.
translations.kjv: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
translations.ron: Şi Isaac a zis: "Iată, eu am îmbătrânit şi nu ştiu ziua morţii mele.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ γεγήρακα, καὶ οὐ γινώσκω τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς τελευτῆς μου.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ንሣእ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ሐቅልከ ፡ ምጐንጳከ ፡ ወቀስተከ ፡ ወፃእ ፡ ሐቅለ ፡ ወነዐው ፡ ሊተ ።
verses.translation: Now then take thy weapons, both thy quiver and thy bow, and go into the plain, and get me venison,

translations.lxx: Now then take thy weapons, both thy quiver and thy bow, and go into the plain, and get me venison,
translations.kjv: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
translations.ron: Ia-ţi dară uneltele tale, tolba şi arcul, şi ieşi la câmp şi adu-mi ceva vânat;
translations.grk: Νῦν οὖν λάβε τὸ σκεῦός σου, τήν τε φαρέτραν, καὶ τὸ τόξον, καὶ ἔξελθε εἰς τὸ πεδίον, καὶ θήρευσόν μοι θήραν.

verses.geez:
ወግበር ፡ ሊተ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ኣፈቅር ፡ ወአምጽእ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እብላዕ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ትባርክ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡
                  እሙት ።
verses.translation: and make me meats, as I like them, and bring them to me that I may eat, that my soul may bless thee, before I die.

translations.lxx: and make me meats, as I like them, and bring them to me that I may eat, that my soul may bless thee, before I die.
translations.kjv: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
translations.ron: Să-mi faci mâncare, cum îmi place mie, şi adu-mi să mănânc, ca să te binecuvânteze sufletul meu până nu mor!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ποίησόν μοι ἐδέσματα, ὡς φιλῶ ἐγὼ, καὶ ἔνεγκέ μοι, ἵνα φάγω, ὅπως εὐλογήσῃ σε ἡ ψυχή μου πρὶν ἀποθανεῖν με.

verses.geez:
ወሰምዐቶ ፡ ርብቃ ፡ ለይስሐቅ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሎ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ሐቅለ ፡ ይንዐው ፡
                  ለአቡሁ ።
verses.translation: And Rebecca heard Isaac speaking to Esau his son; and Esau went to the plain to procure venison for his father.

translations.lxx: And Rebecca heard Isaac speaking to Esau his son; and Esau went to the plain to procure venison for his father.
translations.kjv: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
translations.ron: Rebeca însă a auzit ce a zis Isaac către fiul său Isav. S-a dus deci Isav la câmp să vâneze ceva pentru tatăl său;
translations.grk: Ῥεβέκκα δὲ ἤκουσε λαλοῦντος Ἰσαὰκ πρὸς Ἡσαῦ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ· ἐπορεύθη δὲ Ἡσαῦ εἰς τὸ πεδίον θηρεῦσαι θήραν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወትቤሎ ፡ ርብቃ ፡ ሊያዕቆብ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዘይንእስ ፡ ናሁ ፡ አነ ፡ ሰማዕክዎ ፡ ለአቡከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሎ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡
                  እኁከ ፤
verses.translation: And Rebecca said to Jacob her younger son, Behold, I heard thy father speaking to Esau thy brother, saying,

translations.lxx: And Rebecca said to Jacob her younger son, Behold, I heard thy father speaking to Esau thy brother, saying,
translations.kjv: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
translations.ron: Iar Rebeca a zis către Iacov, fiul cel mai mic: "Iată, eu am auzit pe tatăl tău grăind cu Isav, fratele tău, şi zicând:
translations.grk: Ῥεβέκκα δὲ εἶπε πρὸς τὸν Ἰακὼβ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν ἐλάσσω, ἴδε, ἤκουσα τοῦ πατρός σου λαλοῦντος πρὸς Ἡσαῦ τὸν ἀδελφόν σου, λέγοντος,

verses.geez:
አምጽእ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዘነዐውከ ፡ ወግበር ፡ ሊተ ፡ መባልዕተ ፡ ወእባርከ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡
                  እሙት ።
verses.translation: Bring me venison, and prepare me meats, that I may eat and bless thee before the Lord before I die.

translations.lxx: Bring me venison, and prepare me meats, that I may eat and bless thee before the Lord before I die.
translations.kjv: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.
translations.ron: "Adu vânat şi fă-mi o mâncare să mănânc şi să te binecuvântez înaintea Domnului, până a nu muri".
translations.grk: Ἔνεγκόν μοι θήραν, καὶ ποίησόν μοι ἐδέσματα, ἵνα φαγὼν εὐλογήσω σε ἐναντίον Κυρίου πρὸ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν με.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ እቤለከ ።
verses.translation: Now then, my son, hearken to me, as I command thee.

translations.lxx: Now then, my son, hearken to me, as I command thee.
translations.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
translations.ron: Acum dar, fiul meu, ascultă ce am să-ţi poruncesc:
translations.grk: Νῦν οὖν, υἱέ μου, ἄκουσόν μου, καθὰ ἐγώ σοι ἐντέλλομαι.

verses.geez:
ወሑር ፡ ኀበ ፡ አባግዒነ ፡ ወአምጽእ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ክልኤተ ፡ መሓስአ ፡ በኵረ ፡ ሠናያነ ፡ ወእግበሮሙ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ለአቡከ
                  ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ያፈቅር ።
verses.translation: And go to the cattle and take for me thence two kids, tender and good, and I will make them meats for thy father, as he likes.

translations.lxx: And go to the cattle and take for me thence two kids, tender and good, and I will make them meats for thy father, as he likes.
translations.kjv: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
translations.ron: Du-te la turmă, adu-mi de acolo doi iezi tineri şi buni şi voi face din ei mâncare, cum îi place tatălui tău;
translations.grk: Καὶ πορευθεὶς εἰς τὰ πρόβατα, λάβε μοι ἐκεῖθεν δύο ἐρίφους ἁπαλοὺς καὶ καλοὺς, καὶ ποιήσω αὐτοὺς ἐδέσματα τῷ πατρί σου, ὡς φιλεῖ.

verses.geez: ወትሰድ ፡ ለአቡከ ፡ ወይብላዕ ፡ ወይባርከ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ይሙት ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring them in to thy father, and he shall eat, that thy father may bless thee before he dies.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt bring them in to thy father, and he shall eat, that thy father may bless thee before he dies.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
translations.ron: Iar tu o vei duce tatălui tău să mănânce, ca să te binecuvânteze tatăl tău înainte de a muri".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσοίσεις τῷ πατρί σου, καὶ φάγεται, ὅπως εὐλογήσῃ σε ὁ πατήρ σου πρὸ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ወይቤላ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለርብቃ ፡ እሙ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ እኁየ ፡ ጸጓር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወአንሴ ፡ ኢኮንኩ ፡ ጸጓረ ።
verses.translation: And Jacob said to his mother Rebecca, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I a smooth man.

translations.lxx: And Jacob said to his mother Rebecca, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I a smooth man.
translations.kjv: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
translations.ron: Iacov însă a zis către Rebeca, mama sa: "Isav, fratele meu, e om păros, iar eu n-am păr.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰακὼβ πρὸς Ῥεβέκκαν τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ, ἔστιν Ἡσαῦ ὁ ἀδελφός μου ἀνὴρ δασὺς, ἐγὼ δὲ ἀνὴρ λεῖος.

verses.geez:
ወዮጊ ፡ ይገስሰኒ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወእከውን ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘአስተሐቀሮ ፡ ወኣመጽእ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ መርገመ ፡ ወአኮ ፡
                  በረከተ ።
verses.translation: Peradventure my father may feel me, and I shall be before him as one ill-intentioned, and I shall bring upon me a curse, and not a blessing.

translations.lxx: Peradventure my father may feel me, and I shall be before him as one ill-intentioned, and I shall bring upon me a curse, and not a blessing.
translations.kjv: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
translations.ron: Nu cumva tatăl meu să mă pipăie şi voi fi în ochii lui ca un înşelător şi în loc de binecuvântare, voi atrage asupră-mi blestem".
translations.grk: Μή ποτε ψηλαφήσῃ με ὁ πατὴρ, καὶ ἔσομαι ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ὡς καταφρονῶν, καὶ ἐπάξω ἐπʼ ἐμαυτὸν κατάραν, καὶ οὐκ εὐλογίαν.

verses.geez:
ወትቤሎ ፡ እሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ወልድየ ፡ መርገምከ ፡ ወዳእሙ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ወሑር ፡ ወአምጽእ ፡ ሊት ፡ ዘእቤለከ
                  ።
verses.translation: And his mother said to him, On me be thy curse, son; only hearken to my voice, and go and bring them me.

translations.lxx: And his mother said to him, On me be thy curse, son; only hearken to my voice, and go and bring them me.
translations.kjv: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
translations.ron: Zis-a mama sa: "Fiul meu, asupra mea să fie blestemul acela; ascultă numai povaţa mea şi du-te şi adu-mi iezii!"
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ αὐτῷ ἡ μήτηρ, ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἡ κατάρα σου, τέκνον· μόνον ἐπάκουσόν μου τῆς φωνῆς, καὶ πορευθεὶς ἔνεγκέ μοι.

verses.geez: ወሖረ ፡ ወአምጽአ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ለእሙ ፡ ወአስተደለወት ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ያፈቅር ፡ ለአቡሁ ።
verses.translation: So he went and took and brought them to his mother; and his mother made meats, as his father liked them.

translations.lxx: So he went and took and brought them to his mother; and his mother made meats, as his father liked them.
translations.kjv: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
translations.ron: Atunci, ducându-se Iacov, a luat şi a adus mamei sale iezii, iar mama sa a gătit mâncare, cum îi plăcea tatălui lui.
translations.grk: Πορευθεὶς δὲ ἔλαβε, καὶ ἤνεγκε τῇ μητρί· καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ ἐδέσματα, καθὰ ἐφίλει ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአት ፡ ርብቃ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ ወልዳ ፡ ዘይልህቅ ፡ ዘይሤኒ ፡ ዘሀሎ ፡ ኀቤሃ ፡ ወአልበሰቶ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡
                  ወልዳ ፡ ዘይንእስ ።
verses.translation: And Rebecca having taken the fine raiment of her elder son Esau which was with her in the house, put it on Jacob her younger son.

translations.lxx: And Rebecca having taken the fine raiment of her elder son Esau which was with her in the house, put it on Jacob her younger son.
translations.kjv: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
translations.ron: Apoi a luat Rebeca haina cea mai frumoasă a lui Isav, fiul ei cel mai mare, care era la ea în casă, şi a îmbrăcat pe Iacov, fiul ei cel mai mic;
translations.grk: Καὶ λαβοῦσα Ῥεβέκκα τὴν στολὴν Ἡσαῦ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς τοῦ πρεσβυτέρου τὴν καλὴν, ἣ ἦν παρʼ αὐτῇ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ, ἐνέδυσεν αὐτὴν Ἰακὼβ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν νεώτερον.

verses.geez: ወዝክተሂ ፡ አምእስቲሆሙ ፡ ለክልኤቱ ፡ ማሕስእ ፡ ወደየት ፡ ውስተ ፡ መታክፈሁ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ክሳዱ ።
verses.translation: And she put on his arms the skins of the kids, and on the bare parts of his neck.

translations.lxx: And she put on his arms the skins of the kids, and on the bare parts of his neck.
translations.kjv: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
translations.ron: Iar cu pieile iezilor a înfăşurat braţele şi părţile goale ale gâtului lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὰ δέρματα τῶν ἐρίφων περιέθηκεν ἐπὶ τοὺς βραχίονας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ γυμνὰ τοῦ τραχήλου αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወወሀበቶ ፡ ዝኰ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ወኅብስተኒ ፡ ዘገብረት ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ወልዳ ።
verses.translation: And she gave the meats, and the loaves which she had prepared, into the hands of Jacob her son.

translations.lxx: And she gave the meats, and the loaves which she had prepared, into the hands of Jacob her son.
translations.kjv: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
translations.ron: Şi a dat mâncarea şi pâinea ce gătise în mâinile lui Iacov, fiul său,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκε τὰ ἐδέσματα, καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους οὓς ἐποίησεν, εἰς τὰς χεῖρας Ἰακὼβ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወአብአ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አባ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ነየ ፡ አነ ፡ መኑ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወልድየ ።
verses.translation: And he brought them to his father, and said, Father; and he said, Behold I am here; who art thou, son?

translations.lxx: And he brought them to his father, and said, Father; and he said, Behold I am here; who art thou, son?
translations.kjv: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
translations.ron: Şi acesta a intrat la tatăl său şi a zis: "Tată!" Iar acela a răspuns: "Iată-mă! Cine eşti tu, copilul meu?"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσήνεγκε τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ· εἶπε δὲ, πάτερ· ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ ἐγώ· τίς εἶ σὺ, τέκνον;

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ዘበኵርከ ፡ ገበርኩ ፡ ዘትቤለኒ ፡ ተንሥእ ፡ ንበር ፡ ወብላዕ ፡ እምነ ፡
                  ዘነዐውኩ ፡ ለከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትባርከኒ ፡ ነፍስከ ።
verses.translation: And Jacob said to his father, I, Esau thy first-born, have done as thou toldest me; rise, sit, and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

translations.lxx: And Jacob said to his father, I, Esau thy first-born, have done as thou toldest me; rise, sit, and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
translations.kjv: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
translations.ron: Zis-a Iacov către tatăl său: "Eu sunt Isav, întâiul tău născut. Am făcut precum mi-ai poruncit; scoală şi şezi de mănâncă din vânatul meu, ca să mă binecuvânteze sufletul tău!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰακὼβ τῷ πατρὶ, ἐγὼ Ἡσαῦ ὁ πρωτότοκός σου πεποίηκα καθὰ ἐλάλησάς μοι· ἀναστὰς κάθισον, καὶ φάγε ἀπὸ τῆς θήρας μου, ὅπως εὐλογήσῃ με ἡ ψυχή σου.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ለወልዱ ፡ ምንትኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ዘአፍጠንከ ፡ ረኪበ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ዘወሀበኒ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ቅድሜየ ።
verses.translation: And Isaac said to his son, What is this which thou hast quickly found? And he said, That which the Lord thy God presented before me.

translations.lxx: And Isaac said to his son, What is this which thou hast quickly found? And he said, That which the Lord thy God presented before me.
translations.kjv: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.
translations.ron: Zis-a Isaac către fiul său: "Cum l-ai găsit aşa curând, fiul meu?" Şi acesta a zis: "Domnul Dumnezeul tău mi l-a scos înainte".
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰσαὰκ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ, τί τοῦτο, ὃ ταχὺ εὗρες, ὦ τέκνον; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ὃ παρέδωκε Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου ἐναντίον μου.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ቅረበኒ ፡ ወእግስስከ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አንተኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ወለእመ ፡ ኢኮንከ ።
verses.translation: And Isaac said to Jacob, Draw nigh to me, and I will feel thee, son, if thou art my son Esau or not.

translations.lxx: And Isaac said to Jacob, Draw nigh to me, and I will feel thee, son, if thou art my son Esau or not.
translations.kjv: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
translations.ron: Zis-a Isaac iarăşi către Iacov: "Apropie-te să te pipăi, fiul meu, de eşti tu fiul meu Isav sau nu".
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰσαὰκ τῷ Ἰακὼβ, ἔγγισόν μοι, καὶ ψηλαφήσω σε, τέκνον, εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου Ἡσαῦ, ἢ οὔ.

verses.geez:
ወቀርበ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ [ወገሰሶ ፡] ወይቤ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ቃልሰ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወእደው ፡
                  ዘዔሳው ።
verses.translation: And Jacob drew nigh to his father Isaac, and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

translations.lxx: And Jacob drew nigh to his father Isaac, and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
translations.kjv: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
translations.ron: Şi s-a apropiat Iacov de Isaac, tatăl său, iar acesta l-a pipăit şi a zis: "Glasul este glasul lui Iacov, iar mâinile sunt mâinile lui Isav".
translations.grk: Ἤγγισε δὲ Ἰακὼβ πρὸς Ἰσαὰκ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐψηλάφησεν αὐτὸν, καὶ εἶπεν, ἡ μὲν φωνὴ, φωνὴ Ἰακὼβ, αἱ δὲ χεῖρες, χεῖρες Ἡσαῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢያእመሮ ፡ እስመ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ጸጓር ፡ ከመ ፡ እደወ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ወባረኮ ፡ ይስሐቅ ።
verses.translation: And he knew him not, for his hands were as the hands of his brother Esau, hairy; and he blessed him,

translations.lxx: And he knew him not, for his hands were as the hands of his brother Esau, hairy; and he blessed him,
translations.kjv: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.
translations.ron: Dar nu l-a cunoscut, pentru că mâinile lui erau păroase, ca mâinile fratelui său Isav; şi l-a binecuvântat.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἐπέγνω αὐτὸν, ἦσαν γὰρ αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ, ὡς αἱ χεῖρες Ἡσαῦ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ, δασεῖαι· καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν,

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ አንተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ዔሳው ።
verses.translation: and he said, Art thou my son Esau? and he said, I am.

translations.lxx: and he said, Art thou my son Esau? and he said, I am.
translations.kjv: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
translations.ron: Şi a mai zis: "Tu oare eşti fiul meu Isav?" Şi Iacov a răspuns: "Eu".
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπε, σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου Ἡσαῦ; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ἐγώ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ አምጽእ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዘነዐውከ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ከመ ፡ [እብላዕ ፡ ወ]ትባርከ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ [ወአምጽአ ፡
                  ሎቱ ፡ ወበልዐ ፡ ወአምጽአ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወይነ ፡ ወሰትየ ።]
verses.translation: And he said, Bring hither, and I will eat of thy venison, son, that my soul may bless thee; and he brought it near to him, and he ate, and he brought him wine, and he drank.

translations.lxx: And he said, Bring hither, and I will eat of thy venison, son, that my soul may bless thee; and he brought it near to him, and he ate, and he brought him wine, and he drank.
translations.kjv: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
translations.ron: Zis-a Isaac: "Adu-mi şi voi mânca din vânatul fiului meu, ca să te binecuvânteze sufletul meu!" Şi i-a adus şi a mâncat; apoi i-a adus şi vin şi a băut.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε, προσάγαγέ μοι, καὶ φάγομαι ἀπὸ τῆς θήρας σου, τέκνον, ἵνα εὐλογήσῃ σε ἡ ψυχή μου· καὶ προσήνεγκεν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἔφαγε· καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν αὐτῷ οἶνον, καὶ ἔπιε.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ቅረብ ፡ ወሰዐመኒ ፡ ወልድየ ።
verses.translation: And Isaac his father said to him, Draw nigh to me, and kiss me, son.

translations.lxx: And Isaac his father said to him, Draw nigh to me, and kiss me, son.
translations.kjv: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
translations.ron: După aceea Isaac, tatăl său, i-a zis: "Apropie-te, fiule, şi mă sărută!" â
translations.grk: Καὶ εἴπεν αὐτῷ Ἰσαὰκ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ, ἔγγισόν μοι, καὶ φίλησόν με, τέκνον.

verses.geez:
ወቀርበ ፡ ወሰዐሞ ፡ ወአጼነዎ ፡ ወጼነዎ ፡ ጼና ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ጼናሁ ፡ ለወልድየ ፡ ጼና ፡ ገዳም ፡
                  ጥቀ ፡ ዘባረኮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And he drew nigh and kissed him, and smelled the smell of his garments, and blessed him, and said, Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of an abundant field, which the Lord has blessed.

translations.lxx: And he drew nigh and kissed him, and smelled the smell of his garments, and blessed him, and said, Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of an abundant field, which the Lord has blessed.
translations.kjv: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:
translations.ron: Atunci s-a apropiat Iacov şi l-a sărutat. Şi a simţit Isaac mirosul hainei lui şi l-a binecuvântat şi a zis: "Iată, mirosul fiului meu e ca mirosul unui câmp bogat, pe care l-a binecuvântat Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγγίσας ἐφίλησεν αὐτόν· καὶ ὠσφράνθη τὴν ὀσμὴν τῶν ἱματίων αὐτοῦ, καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν, καὶ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ ὀσμὴ τοῦ υἱοῦ μου, ὡς ὀσμὴ ἀγροῦ πλήρους, ὃν εὐλόγησε Κύριος.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ የሀብከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምጠለ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወእምጠለ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወያብዝኅ ፡ ስርናየከ ፡ ወወይነከ ።
verses.translation: And may God give thee of the dew of heaven, and of the fatness of the earth, and abundance of corn and wine.

translations.lxx: And may God give thee of the dew of heaven, and of the fatness of the earth, and abundance of corn and wine.
translations.kjv: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
translations.ron: Să-ţi dea ţie Dumnezeu din roua cerului şi din belşugul pământului, pâine multă şi vin.
translations.grk: Καὶ δῴη σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἀπὸ τῆς δρόσου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς πιότητος τῆς γῆς, καὶ πλῆθος σίτου καὶ οἴνου.

verses.geez:
ወይትቀነዩ ፡ ለከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወይስግዱ ፡ ለከ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወኩን ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለእኁከ ፡ ወይስግዱ ፡ ለከ ፡ ደቂቀ
                  ፡ አቡከ ፡ ዘይባርከከ ፡ ቡሩከ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ወዘይረግመከ ፡ ርጉም ።
verses.translation: And let nations serve thee, and princes bow down to thee, and be thou lord of thy brother, and the sons of thy father shall do thee reverence; accursed is he that curses thee, and blessed is he that blesses thee.

translations.lxx: And let nations serve thee, and princes bow down to thee, and be thou lord of thy brother, and the sons of thy father shall do thee reverence; accursed is he that curses thee, and blessed is he that blesses thee.
translations.kjv: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
translations.ron: Să-ţi slujească popoarele şi căpeteniile să se închine înaintea ta; să fii stăpân peste fraţii tăi şi feciorii mamei tale să ţi se închine ţie; cel ce te va blestema să fie blestemat şi binecuvântat să fie cel ce te va binecuvânta!"
translations.grk: Καὶ δουλευσάτωσάν σοι ἔθνη, καὶ προσκυνησάτωσάν σοι ἄρχοντες· καὶ γίνου κύριος τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου, καὶ προσκυνήσουσί σοι οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ πατρός σου· ὁ καταρώμενός σε, ἐπικατάρατος· ὁ δὲ εὐλογῶν σε, εὐλογημένος.

verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ ፡ አኅለቀ ፡ ባርኮቶ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወወጽአ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ አቡሁ ፡
                  ወመጽአ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ እምናዕዌ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after Isaac had ceased blessing his son Jacob, it even came to pass, just when Jacob had gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after Isaac had ceased blessing his son Jacob, it even came to pass, just when Jacob had gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
translations.ron: Îndată ce a isprăvit Isaac de binecuvântat pe Iacov, fiul său, şi cum a ieşit Iacov de la faţa tatălui său Isaac, a venit şi Isav cu vânatul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὸ παύσασθαι Ἰσαὰκ εὐλογοῦντα Ἰακὼβ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐγένετο, ὡς ἂν ἐξῆλθεν Ἰακὼβ ἀπὸ προσώπου Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ἡσαῦ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν ἀπὸ τῆς θήρας.

verses.geez:
ወገብረ ፡ ውእቱሂ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ወአምጽአ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ተንሥእ ፡ አባ ፡ ወብላዕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዘነዐወ ፡ ለከ ፡
                  ወልድከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትባርከኒ ፡ ነፍስከ ።
verses.translation: And he also had made meats and brought them to his father; and he said to his father, Let my father arise and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

translations.lxx: And he also had made meats and brought them to his father; and he said to his father, Let my father arise and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
translations.kjv: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.
translations.ron: A făcut şi el bucate şi le-a adus tatălui său şi a zis către tatăl său: "Scoală, tată, şi mănâncă din vânatul fiului tău, ca să mă binecuvânteze sufletul tău!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδέσματα, καὶ προσήνεγκε τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ· καὶ εἶπε τῷ πατρὶ, ἀναστήτω ὁ πατήρ μου, καὶ φαγέτω ἀπὸ τῆς θήρας τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ, ὅπως εὐλογήσῃ με ἡ ψυχή σου.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ መኑ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ አነ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ዘበኵርከ ፡ ዔሳው ።
verses.translation: And Isaac his father said to him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy first-born son Esau.

translations.lxx: And Isaac his father said to him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy first-born son Esau.
translations.kjv: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
translations.ron: Iar Isaac, tatăl său, i-a zis: "Cine eşti tu?" Iar el a zis: "Eu sunt Isav, fiul tău cel întâi-născut!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἰσαὰκ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ, τίς εἶ σύ; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ υἱός σου ὁ πρωτότοκος Ἡσαῦ.

verses.geez:
ወደንገፀ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ድንጋፄ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ መኑመ ፡ ዘአምጽአ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ዘነዐወ ፡ ወበላዕኩ ፡ ወባረክዎ
                  ፡ ወቡሩክ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And Isaac was amazed with very great amazement, and said, Who then is it that has procured venison for me and brought it to me? and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and I have blessed him, and he shall be blessed.

translations.lxx: And Isaac was amazed with very great amazement, and said, Who then is it that has procured venison for me and brought it to me? and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and I have blessed him, and he shall be blessed.
translations.kjv: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a cutremurat Isaac cu cutremur mare foarte şi a zis: "Dar cine-i acela, care a căutat şi mi-a adus vânat şi am mâncat de la el înainte de a veni tu şi l-am binecuvântat şi binecuvântat va fi?"
translations.grk: Ἐξέστη δὲ Ἰσαὰκ ἔκστασιν μεγάλην σφόδρα, καὶ εἶπε, τίς οὖν ὁ θηρεύσας μοι θήραν καὶ εἰσενέγκας μοι, καὶ ἔφαγον ἀπὸ πάντων πρὸ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν σε; καὶ εὐλόγησα αὐτὸν, καὶ εὐλογημένος ἔσται.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይሰምዕ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ቃለ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ጸርኀ ፡ በዐቢይ ፡ ቃል ፡ ወአምረረ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ባርከኒ ፡
                  ኪያየኒ ፡ አባ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when Esau heard the words of his father Isaac, he cried out with a great and very bitter cry, and said, Bless, I pray thee, me also, father.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when Esau heard the words of his father Isaac, he cried out with a great and very bitter cry, and said, Bless, I pray thee, me also, father.
translations.kjv: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
translations.ron: Iar Isav, auzind cuvintele tatălui său Isaac, a strigat cu glas mare şi foarte dureros şi a zis către tatăl său: "Binecuvântează-mă şi pe mine, tată!"
translations.grk: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἤκουσεν Ἡσαῦ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἰσαὰκ, ἀνεβόησε φωνὴν μεγάλην καὶ πικρὰν σφόδρα· καὶ εἶπεν, εὐλόγησον δὴ κᾀμὲ, πάτερ.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ መጽአ ፡ እኁከ ፡ በጐሕሉት ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ በረከተከ ።
verses.translation: And he said to him, Thy brother has come with subtlety, and taken thy blessing.

translations.lxx: And he said to him, Thy brother has come with subtlety, and taken thy blessing.
translations.kjv: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
translations.ron: Zis-a Isaac către el: "A venit fratele tău cu înşelăciune şi a luat binecuvântarea ta".
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ αὐτῷ, ἐλθὼν ὁ ἀδελφός σου μετὰ δόλου ἔλαβε τὴν εὐλογίαν σου.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ተሰምየ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ እስመ ፡ አዕቀጸኒ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ ዳግሙ ፡ ዮም ፤ በኵርየኒ ፡ ነሥአኒ ፡
                  ወናሁ ፡ ዮምኒ ፡ በረከትየ ፡ ነሥአኒ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ አልቦኑ ፡ አባ ፡ ዘአትረፍከ ፡ በረከተ ፡ ሊትኒ ፡ አባ ።
verses.translation: And he said, Rightly was his name called Jacob, for lo! this second time has he supplanted me; he has both taken my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing; and Esau said to his father, Hast thou not left a blessing for me, father?

translations.lxx: And he said, Rightly was his name called Jacob, for lo! this second time has he supplanted me; he has both taken my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing; and Esau said to his father, Hast thou not left a blessing for me, father?
translations.kjv: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
translations.ron: Iar Isav a zis: "Din pricină oare că-l cheamă Iacov, de aceea m-a înşelat de două ori? Deunăzi mi-a răpit dreptul de întâi-născut, iar acum mi-a răpit binecuvântarea mea". Apoi a zis Isav către tatăl său: "Nu mi-ai păstrat şi mie binecuvântare, tată?"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε, δικαίως ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰακὼβ, ἐπτέρνικε γάρ με ἰδοὺ δεύτερον τοῦτο· τά τε πρωτοτόκιά μου εἴληφε, καὶ νῦν ἔλαβε τὴν εὐλογίαν μου· καὶ εἶπεν Ἡσαῦ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ, οὐχ ὑπελίπου μοι εὐλογίαν, πάτερ;

verses.geez:
ወአውሥአ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ እግዚአከ ፡ ረሰይክዎ ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ አኀዊሁ ፡ አግብርቲሁ ፡ ረሰይኩ ፡
                  ወአብዛኅኩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወይኖ ፡ ወስርናዮ ፡ ወለከ ፡ ምንተ ፡ እረሲ ፡ ወልድየ ።
verses.translation: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, If I have made him thy lord, and have made all his brethren his servants, and have strengthened him with corn and wine, what then shall I do for thee, son?

translations.lxx: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, If I have made him thy lord, and have made all his brethren his servants, and have strengthened him with corn and wine, what then shall I do for thee, son?
translations.kjv: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
translations.ron: Răspuns-a Isaac şi a zis lui Isav: "Iată, stăpân l-am făcut peste tine şi pe toţi fraţii lui i-am făcut lui robi; cu pâine şi cu vin l-am dăruit. Dar cu tine ce să fac, fiul meu?"
translations.grk: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ἰσαὰκ εἶπε τῷ Ἡσαῦ, εἰ κύριον αὐτὸν πεποίηκά σου, καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ πεποίηκα αὐτοῦ οἰκέτας· σίτῳ καὶ οἴνῳ ἐστήριξα αὐτόν· σοὶ δὲ τί ποιήσω, τέκνον;

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ለይስሐቅ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ አሐቲኑ ፡ ክመ ፡ ሊከሰ ፡ በረከትከ ፡ አባ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ ጸርኀ ፡ ዔሳው ፡
                  ወበከየ ።
verses.translation: And Esau said to his father, Hast thou only one blessing, father? Bless, I pray thee, me also, father. And Isaac being troubled, Esau cried aloud and wept.

translations.lxx: And Esau said to his father, Hast thou only one blessing, father? Bless, I pray thee, me also, father. And Isaac being troubled, Esau cried aloud and wept.
translations.kjv: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Isav către tatăl său: "Tată, oare numai o binecuvântare ai tu? Binecuvântează-mă şi pe mine, tată:" Şi cum Isaac tăcea, Isav şi-a ridicat glasul şi a început a plânge.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἡσαῦ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ, μὴ εὐλογία μία σοι ἔστι, πάτερ; εὐλόγησον δὴ κᾀμὲ, πάτερ· κατανυχθέντος δὲ Ἰσαὰκ, ἀνεβόησε φωνῇ Ἡσαῦ, καὶ ἔκλαυσεν.

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ናሁ ፡ እምጠለ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ዘእምላዕሉ ፡ ወእምጠለ ፡ ምድር ፡ ይኩን ፡ ሕይወትከ ።
verses.translation: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above.

translations.lxx: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above.
translations.kjv: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
translations.ron: Atunci, răspunzând Isaac, tatăl lui, a zis către el: "Iată, locuinţa ta va fi un pământ mănos şi cerul îţi va trimite roua sa;
translations.grk: Ἀποκοιθεὶς δὲ Ἰσαὰκ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ἰδοὺ ἀπὸ τῆς πιότητος τῆς γῆς ἔσται ἡ κατοίκησίς σου, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δρόσου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἄνωθεν.

verses.geez: ወበመጥባሕትከ ፡ ሕየው ፡ ወትትቀነይ ፡ ለእኁከ ፡ ወእመ ፡ ትፈቅድ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ ትግድፍ ፡ ጾሮ ፡ እምላዕለ ፡ ክሳድከ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt live by thy sword, and shalt serve thy brother; and there shall be a time when thou shalt break and loosen his yoke from off thy neck.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt live by thy sword, and shalt serve thy brother; and there shall be a time when thou shalt break and loosen his yoke from off thy neck.
translations.kjv: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
translations.ron: Cu sabia ta vei trăi şi vei fi supus fratelui tău; va veni însă vremea când te vei ridica şi vei sfărâma jugul lui de pe grumazul tău".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ μαχαίρᾳ σου ζήσῃ, καὶ τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου δουλεύσεις· ἔσται δὲ ἡνίκα ἐὰν καθέλῃς καὶ ἐκλύσῃς τὸν ζυγὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ τραχήλου σου.

verses.geez:
ወይጸልኦ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ በእንተ ፡ በረከቱ ፡ ዘባረኮ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ በልቡ ፡ ለትቅረቦ
                  ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ላሑ ፡ ለአቡየ ፡ ከመ ፡ እቅትሎ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ እኁየ ።
verses.translation: And Esau was angry with Jacob because of the blessing, with which his father blessed him; and Esau said in his mind, Let the days of my father's mourning draw nigh, that I may slay my brother Jacob.

translations.lxx: And Esau was angry with Jacob because of the blessing, with which his father blessed him; and Esau said in his mind, Let the days of my father's mourning draw nigh, that I may slay my brother Jacob.
translations.kjv: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
translations.ron: De aceea ura Isav pe Iacov pentru binecuvântarea cu care-l binecuvântase tatăl său. Şi a zis Isav în cugetul său: "Se apropie zilele de jelire pentru tatăl meu; atunci am să ucid pe Iacov, fratele meu!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνεκότει Ἡσαῦ τῷ Ἰακὼβ περὶ τῆς εὐλογίας, ἧς εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ· εἶπε δὲ Ἡσαῦ ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ αὐτοῦ, ἐγγισάτωσαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ πένθους τοῦ πατρός μου, ἵνα ἀποκτείνω Ἰακὼβ τὸν ἀδελφόν μου.

verses.geez:
ወአይድዕዋ ፡ ለርብቃ ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ ወልዳ ፡ ዘይልህቅ ፡ ወለአከት ፡ ወጸውዐቶ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ወልዳ ፡ ዘይንእስ ፡ ወትቤሎ
                  ፡ ናሁ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ እኁከ ፡ ይንዕወከ ፡ ወይፈቅድ ፡ ይቅትልከ ።
verses.translation: And the words of Esau her elder son were reported to Rebecca, and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, Behold, Esau thy brother threatens thee to kill thee.

translations.lxx: And the words of Esau her elder son were reported to Rebecca, and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, Behold, Esau thy brother threatens thee to kill thee.
translations.kjv: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
translations.ron: Dar i s-a spus Rebecăi cuvintele lui Isav, fiul cel mai mare, şi ea a trimis de a chemat pe Iacov, fiul ei cel mai mic, şi i-a zis: "Iată Isav, fratele tău, vrea să se răzbune pe tine, omorându-te.
translations.grk: Ἀπηγγέλη δὲ Ῥεβέκκᾳ τὰ ῥήματα Ἡσαῦ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς τοῦ πρεσβυτέρου· καὶ πέμψασα ἐκάλεσεν Ἰακὼβ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν νεώτερον, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ἰδοὺ Ἡσαῦ ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἀπειλεῖ σοι τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναί σε.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜኒ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ዘእብለከ ፡ ወተንሥእ ፡ ሑር ፡ ማእከለ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ላባ ፡ እኁየ ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ ካራን ።
verses.translation: Now then, my son, hear my voice, and rise and depart quickly into Mesopotamia to Laban my brother into Charran.

translations.lxx: Now then, my son, hear my voice, and rise and depart quickly into Mesopotamia to Laban my brother into Charran.
translations.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
translations.ron: Acum dar, fiul meu, ascultă povaţa mea şi, sculându-te, fugi la Haran, în Mesopotamia, la fratele meu Laban,
translations.grk: Νῦν οὖν, τέκνον, ἄκουσόν μου τῆς φωνῆς, καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀπόδραθι εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν πρὸς Λάβαν τὸν ἀδελφόν μου εἰς Χαῤῥάν.

verses.geez: ወንበር ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ኅዳጠ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይቈርር ፡ መዓቱ ፡ ለእኁከ ፤
verses.translation: And dwell with him certain days, until thy brother's anger

translations.lxx: And dwell with him certain days, until thy brother's anger
translations.kjv: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;
translations.ron: Şi stai la el câtva timp, până se va potoli mânia fratelui tău
translations.grk: Καὶ οἴκησον μετʼ αὐτοῦ ἡμέρας τινὰς, ἕως τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι τὸν θυμὸν,

verses.geez: ወይረስዕ ፡ ዘገበርካሁ ፡ ወእልእክ ፡ ወእቄብለከ ፡ በህየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ክልኤክሙ ፡ ኢይሕጐል ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: and rage depart from thee, and he forget what thou hast done to him; and I will send and fetch thee thence, lest at any time I should be bereaved of you both in one day.

translations.lxx: and rage depart from thee, and he forget what thou hast done to him; and I will send and fetch thee thence, lest at any time I should be bereaved of you both in one day.
translations.kjv: Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
translations.ron: Şi până va mai uita el ce i-ai făcut. Atunci voi trimite şi te voi lua de acolo. Pentru ce să rămân eu într-o singură zi fără de voi amândoi?"
translations.grk: καὶ τὴν ὀργὴν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου ἀπὸ σοῦ, καὶ ἐπιλάθηται ἃ πεποίηκας αὐτῷ· καὶ ἀποστείλασα μεταπέμψομαί σε ἐκεῖθεν, μή ποτε ἀποτεκνωθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν δύο ὑμῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ.

verses.geez:
ወትቤሎ ፡ ርብቃ ፡ ለይስሐቅ ፡ ጸላእኩ ፡ ሕይወትየ ፡ እምአዋልደ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ወእመሰ ፡ ይነሥእ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡
                  እምአዋልደ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ለምንት ፡ እንከ ፡ ሊተ ፡ አሐዩ ።
verses.translation: And Rebecca said to Isaac, I am weary of my life, because of the daughters of the sons of Chet; if Jacob shall take a wife of the daughters of this land, wherefore should I live?

translations.lxx: And Rebecca said to Isaac, I am weary of my life, because of the daughters of the sons of Chet; if Jacob shall take a wife of the daughters of this land, wherefore should I live?
translations.kjv: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
translations.ron: Apoi Rebeca a zis către Isaac: "Sunt scârbită de viaţa mea, din pricina fetelor Heteilor. Dacă-şi ia şi Iacov femeie ca acestea, din fetele pământului acestuia, atunci la ce-mi mai e bună viaţa?"
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ῥεβέκκα πρὸς Ἰσαὰκ, προσώχθικα τῇ ζωῇ μου διὰ τὰς θυγατέρας τῶν υἱῶν Χέτ· εἰ λήψεται Ἰακὼβ γυναῖκα ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τῆς γῆς ταύτης, ἵνα τί μοι τὸ ζῇν;
